description: jQuery UI Checkboxradio widget implementation, providing themeable checkboxes and radio buttons with enhanced UI features.

classes.name: ui.checkboxradio
classes.description: A widget class that enhances checkboxes and radio buttons with custom styling and behavior.

methods.name: _getCreateOptions
methods.description: Initializes widget options based on element attributes and label content.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Sets up the widget, binds events, and applies initial styling.

methods.name: _readType
methods.description: Validates that the element is an input of type checkbox or radio.

methods.name: _enhance
methods.description: Updates the icon state based on whether the input is checked.

methods.name: widget
methods.description: Returns the label element associated with the widget.

methods.name: _getRadioGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all radio buttons in the same group.

methods.name: _toggleClasses
methods.description: Updates CSS classes based on the checked state.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Removes widget enhancements and event handlers.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets widget options and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Updates the icon appearance based on checked state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the widget state to match the underlying input.
